data.one_liner: Add inline WebViews, headless WebViews, and in-app browser windows.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to embed web content via inline webviews, run headless webviews, and open in-app browser windows across multiple platforms like Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Web. Supports advanced JavaScript communication, custom navigation handling, and permission requests.
use_when: You need to embed full-featured web content directly into your Flutter app views.
You need an in-app browser experience with custom controls and event handling.
You require cross-platform webview support including Windows and macOS.
avoid_when: You only need to launch URLs externally in the device's default browser.
You want a minimal official Flutter team plugin and prefer relying strictly on webview_flutter.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Web.
Provides advanced features like headless webviews, cookie management, and JavaScript handlers.
Extensive API and documentation for deep control over web view behavior.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific setup and configuration steps for Android, iOS, macOS, and Windows.
Heavy dependency tree with separate platform implementation packages.
data.setup_notes: Requires platform installation setup for Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Web, including minimum SDK versions and configuration in native files.

alternatives.name: webview_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want the official Flutter team maintained webview package with simpler default use cases.
